architecture_note: ScorpionProjection has a decoder (decoder.0, decoder.2) that maps concat(biological, acquisition) -> original feature space. Decoder weights are available in all checkpoints. We use both decoder-based feature-space reconstruction AND branch-space probe metrics for the swap audit.

metrics.acquisition_category_leakage: fraction of swaps where category prediction matches acq source category
metrics.biological_scanner_leakage: fraction of swaps where scanner prediction matches bio source scanner
metrics.category_preservation_rate: fraction of swaps where category prediction matches bio source category
metrics.scanner_follow_rate: fraction of swaps where scanner prediction matches acq source scanner

swap_types.A_same_sample_diff_scanner: bio and acq from same sample/region, different scanners
swap_types.B_same_category_diff_sample: bio and acq from same category, different samples, different scanners
swap_types.C_diff_category_diff_scanner: bio and acq from different categories, different scanners
swap_types.D_random_acquisition: bio source fixed, acq source random
